evals.name: canonical-trigger
evals.expected_output: Skill gathers candidates from all 5 sources for Y, ≥3 sources for T, presents numbered list per section, assembles a draft in Joyce's Y:/T:[/B:] format with • and ◦ bullets and inline <url|text> links. Auto-select all candidates for the assembled draft.

evals.name: slash-command
evals.expected_output: Same pipeline as canonical trigger, invoked via slash command.

evals.name: ooo-yesterday
evals.prompt: draft my standup for today, I was off yesterday so light Y section
evals.expected_output: Skill handles sparse Y candidates gracefully (≤2 items or 'no activity found'), still produces a normal T section, doesn't pad Y with fake items.

evals.name: skip-send-override
evals.prompt: write my standup but skip the slack send and just print it here
evals.expected_output: Skill runs the full gathering and assembly pipeline but does not call mcp__slack__slack_send_message — prints the draft inline instead.
